Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), leukocyturia, nitrites, hematuria, and positive leukocyte esterase, consistent with a urinary tract infection. The presence of glucose in urine may warrant further evaluation for glycosuria/diabetes. Low specific gravity could indicate dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
